question.text: Chlorophyll extracted from the crushed green leaves was dissolved in water to make <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> solution of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Mg</mi></math> of concentration $48 \mathrm{ppm}$. The number of atoms of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Mg</mi></math> in this solution is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>20</mn></msup></math> atoms. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is (Nearest Integer) (Given : Atomic mass of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Mg</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>24</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>02</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>23</mn></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>)

solution.text:
Chlorophyll is the green pigment in plants, algae, and cyanobacteria that is essential for photosynthesis. Its central structure is an aromatic porphyrin ring system with a sequestered magnesium atom.

ppm=WMgVsol×106=48

nMg=WMg24=48×2×10-324

Number of Mg atoms =4×10-3×6.02×1023=4×6.02×1020

=4×6.02×1020

=24.08×1020

∴ x=24.08
